name: Northbridge Business Finance Ltd
profile: Manchester-based SME lender. FCA-authorised for consumer credit lending (regulated loans up to £25,000 to sole traders and small partnerships under the Consumer Credit Act) and also lends unregulated term loans of £25,000–£500,000 to limited companies. Around 4,200 live loans. Not PRA-regulated and not a deposit taker. Applications arrive direct and through about 60 introducers (commercial finance brokers and some asset-finance firms). Uses a credit bureau scorecard and an in-house rules engine for automated credit decisions, a third-party KYC and sanctions screening vendor, and is piloting 'Nudge', an LLM-based agentic collections assistant that messages customers in early arrears and proposes payment plans. SM&CR core firm.
